name: openscad-language
description: OpenSCAD language support for Visual Studio Code.

openscad.bosl2.highlighting.enabled.description: Highlight BOSL2 documentation comments. Customizer annotations use the same color and are always highlighted.

openscad.targetVersion.description: OpenSCAD version used for built-in highlighting, completion, hover, and signature help.

openscad.experimentalFeatures.description: Experimental OpenSCAD features to recognize for the Nightly target. Enable the same features in OpenSCAD to run the code.

openscad.executablePath.description: Absolute path to the OpenSCAD executable, such as openscad.exe. Used to locate the installation libraries when no installation library path is set.

openscad.userLibraryPath.description: Absolute path to the OpenSCAD user libraries directory. Leave empty to use the platform default.

openscad.extraLibraryPaths.description: Additional absolute folders for resolving use and include imports in VS Code. Searched in order after OPENSCADPATH and before the user and installation library folders.

openscad.installationLibraryPath.description: Absolute path to the libraries directory for your OpenSCAD installation. Leave empty to search standard installation locations.

openscad.regions.enabled.description: Enable folding and highlighting for #region and #endregion comments.

colors.description: Text color of OpenSCAD region opening and closing comments.
Text color for BOSL2 documentation bodies and OpenSCAD Customizer annotations.
